system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no prompt construction mechanism shown (prompts referenced in appendices not in evidence).

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
the Planner Agent AP de-
termines the next observation target according to
the questionQ, the global video description DV ,
and the current Working Memory MW .
env_context_strategy.note: Global video description injected up front (summary) plus agent-driven observation tools over hierarchical memory (keyword/description matching). Closest fit for video domain.

context_compaction.note: No history compaction mechanism described; paper only, no code.

observation_format.note: Observation tools return video segments to an Omni-LLM; value list has no video/audio modality. Not coded without code.

tool_call_format.note: Planner specifies tool name and parameter keywords (Fig. 2) but syntax not reported.

tool_count.evidence_quote:
To support
flexible perception over long videos, AOP-Agent
employs a set of complementary observation tools.
tool_count.note: Five observation tools listed: description-based, keyword-guided, keypoint-guided, neighbor, fine-grained.

edit_primitive.note: Not a file-editing system; no tool registry available to confirm absence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
AOP-Agent performs
active perception through a multi-agent observe-reflect-replan loop.
loop_primitives.note: Planner selects observation, tools execute, reflector judges sufficiency and triggers replan; closest values.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
the Planner Agent AP de-
termines the next observation target according to
the questionQ, the global video description DV ,
and the current Working Memory MW .
planning_granularity.note: Fig. 2 shows 'Plan for Henceforth' / 'Future Plan' stored; structure inferred from figure.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
Once sufficient information has been accu-
mulated across iterations, the Reasoner AgentAA
generates the final answer based on the collected
observations.
multi_agent_topology.note: Planner -> tools -> Reflector -> (replan) -> Reasoner; specialised role agents with fixed hand-off plus loop.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
The Reflector AgentAR evaluates whether the cur-
rent observations are sufficient for reasoning and
provides feedback for subsequent replanning if nec-
essary.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
The se-
lected observation tool then retrieves the corre-
sponding mid-level segments for further inspec-
tion and stores them in the Evidence MemoryME.
short_term_state.note: Working memory and evidence memory maintained across iterations.

long_term_memory.note: Hierarchical omni-modal memory is per-video, built offline; cross-run persistence not reported.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
the reflector
agentAR evaluates whether the
current information is sufficient or further obser-
vation is needed.
self_verification.note: Separate reflector agent call (same backbone by default) judges evidence sufficiency; could also be read as self_critique.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
increasing the maximum obser-
vation rounds from 1 to 3 improves performance
termination_condition.note: Reflector decides sufficiency (model-declared) and a max observation round limit exists.

eval_hooks.note: No repo; evaluated on MOV-Bench and OmniVideoBench in paper.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
an agentic framework for ac-
tive omni-modal perception under low-resource
settings.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
we implement AOP-Agent using
Qwen3-Omni-Thinking, Qwen3-Omni-Instruct,
and Qwen2.5-Omni-7B as backbone models
model_agnostic.note: Backbone-swappable across open-source Omni-LLMs; no client abstraction shown.

first_release_date.note: Fallback to paper v1 date; no repo.

pinned_version.note: No repo; pinned to paper version.
